q: Which grid emission factor should a Vietnamese supplier use?
title: Grid factor for Vietnamese suppliers
short: Use the national grid emission factor published by Vietnam's environment ministry for the year your electricity was used, and cite it. Recent figures are around two thirds of a kilogram of CO2 per kWh, reflecting a grid with a large coal share, so electricity is a big part of most suppliers' footprints.
audience: Steel, cement, textile and electronics suppliers in Vietnam answering buyer Scope 2 questions

ul: Location based Scope 2: the national grid factor for the year.
Market based Scope 2: renewable certificates or direct power purchase contracts that meet the Scope 2 Quality Criteria.
CBAM: for cement the electricity factor changes the cost; for steel and aluminium electricity is reported, not charged.

p: Record the publication, its year and the value used. Update when a new figure is published, and do not mix years in one report.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills and fuel invoices into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record per site. Grid factors outside India must be entered from the official source for the country and year, and are labelled with that source.
